Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual lands twenty to forty above the tightest open bin, anchoring the sweet band to the current minimum, while keeping the mid penalty. This adapts the target to each state, but the offset is a guess and the band may rarely trigger.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= min(bins) + 20 and r - item <= min(bins) + 40 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
